Sizzling Skillets & Fresh Artisan Banh Mi
Vietnamese Restaurant In Honolulu, HI 96826
Some of the best memories begin around a hot pan and a warm loaf of bread. Inspired by the flavors of Vietnam and the relaxed island spirit of Honolulu, IRON PAN brings together comforting food, handcrafted flavors, and genuine hospitality in every meal.

SIZZLING SKILLETS MADE WITH CARE
Every sizzling skillet is prepared with tradition, care, and the little details that make every meal memorable.
FRESH INGREDIENTS EVERY DAY

COMFORTING FLAVORS & WARM HOSPITALITY

Our Menu
BANH MI COLLECTION
Fresh-baked baguette, house pickles, fresh vegetables.
Lemongrass BBQ Pork Banh Mi
$11
Fragrant lemongrass-marinated pork, grilled to a perfect caramelized edge, tucked inside a warm, crispy baguette with bright house pickles and fresh, crunchy vegetables.
Signature Meatball Banh Mi
$11
Juicy, flavorful Vietnamese meatballs simmered in a savory sauce, paired with a crisp baguette, house-made pickles, and refreshing vegetables for the perfect balance of richness and freshness.
House Special Banh Mi
$11
A classic Vietnamese favorite featuring premium cold cuts and silky house-made pâté, layered inside a warm baguette with tangy pickles and fresh herbs for a bold, unforgettable bite.
Sauteed Beef & Eggs Banh Mi
$11
Tender sautéed beef with rich, golden eggs, combined with house pickles and crisp vegetables inside a freshly baked baguette — hearty, savory, and deeply satisfying.

THE HEART BEHIND EVERY IRON PAN
We believe great food begins with authentic ingredients, meaningful connections, and the comfort of sharing a meal together. Our kitchen combines tradition, care, and warm hospitality to turn everyday dining into something memorable
CRAFTED SKILLETS & FRESH FLAVORS
Our menu brings together sizzling iron skillets, warm artisan bread, and carefully prepared ingredients inspired by the comforting flavors of Vietnam. Every dish is made fresh to order and served with care
A WELCOMING NEIGHBORHOOD EXPERIENCE
Stepping into IRON PAN means stepping into a warm and inviting space where friends and family can gather, relax, and enjoy comforting food together. We want every visit to feel familiar, personal, and memorable.
